requirement: Offshore wind turbines must maintain a minimum clearance of 22 nautical miles from shipping lanes
Substations must comply with ISO 19901-5 for structural integrity
All wind turbines must maintain a minimum clearance of 1 km from migratory bird pathways.
Substation foundations must comply with ISO 19902 standards for offshore structures.
All projects must conduct a full Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) prior to construction
scope: All offshore wind developments in federal waters

requirement: Wind turbine foundations must withstand 1-in-50-year extreme wave conditions
scope: Fixed-bottom turbine installations in North Sea

requirement: Minimum clearance of 22 meters between lowest blade tip and highest astronomical tide
scope: All offshore wind turbines in UK waters
source: UK Marine and Coastal Access Act 2009
